nodes.title: package.json
nodes.body: The root package version is the release source of truth. Cargo.lock records the matching Ridge package version, and the release version contract requires both values to equal the pushed v-prefixed tag.

nodes.title: Cargo.toml
nodes.body: The desktop Ridge crate version matches the root release version exactly before a release tag is created.

nodes.title: tauri.conf.json
nodes.body: Tauri bundle metadata carries the same release version as package.json, the Ridge crate, Cargo.lock, and the Git tag.
